env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd o0test
logos build -a -x .
stderr '\-N \-l'
stderr 'variablemakethreshold=32'
cd ..
cd o1test
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'inlbudget'
! stderr 'variablemakethreshold'
! stderr '\-N \-l'
cd ..
cd ostest
logos build -a -x .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=15'
! stderr 'variablemakethreshold'
cd ..

-- o0test/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/o0test

go 1.27

-- o0test/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O0"

-- o0test/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}

-- o1test/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/o1test

go 1.27

-- o1test/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O1"

-- o1test/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}

-- ostest/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/ostest

go 1.27

-- ostest/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "Os"

-- ostest/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
